title: Mobile App Introduction and Online and Offline Purchases and Product Returns
eligible_reason: Not staggered. Retailer mobile-app launch is a single common date (post = month > 18, i.e., from July 2014 for all shoppers; verified in APPDATA2019.csv: every treated shopper's treatxpost turns on in month 19). Regression is reg y treat treatxpost imr i.month with a pooled adopter dummy instead of shopper FE and an inverse Mills ratio control from a selection model, on a matched adopter/non-adopter sample.
design_notes: code.do: reg {frq,qty,val}_purchases treat treatxpost imr i.month, vce(cluster zip). 200 shoppers x 36 months (Jan 2013-Dec 2015), 100 app adopters. Treatment = app adoption, but post is defined by the common app-launch month, so the DiD is a 2x2 with month FE.
data_files_note: README: 'The data is simulated due to the non-disclosure agreement'; 'A random sample of matched treated and control units' with simulated purchase outcomes (7,200 rows).
data_provenance_note: README states data are simulated under an NDA.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from README, code, data and OpenAlex abstract. Even with real data the design fails on timing (single launch date), pooled treat dummy instead of unit FE, and the time-invariant-but-generated IMR regressor.
